attempts_log.asr_text: Some mornings, the employee chooses a quiet corner because they need to think. On other days, they sit where conversation is easy. A different desk can bring them closer to people from another department. It can also give them distance when a workplace relationship feels uncomfortable, or when they simply need room. Since working from home gave them a place of their own, they don’t need one fixed spot at the office. They value being able to change their surroundings and choose a place that fits their mood, their task, and the people they need or do not need around them.
